4th Period.connections: For two weeks your page has been HTML for structure and CSS for looks — both frozen the second the page loads. Today you add the third language, JavaScript, and your page starts reacting to you. That same click-and-respond idea is what runs the Snake game you'll have working by Sunday.

Thursday that same variable is what makes your shape grow and shrink.
